outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmented rendering (structural/schematic model) of the apical end showing preconoidal rings and an actin filament; it is not a plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel B is a 3D segmented rendering of the basal end showing actin bundles and IMC; not a plot.
Panel C is a tomographic slice (micrograph) with highlighted filaments; not a plot.
Panel D is a schematic/model drawing of a lateral section showing actin populations; not a plot.
Panel E is a tomographic average slice (micrograph); not a plot.
Panel F is a tomographic slice (micrograph) showing filament-density connections; not a plot.
